newsitem.title: USA: Nasdaq shows moderate gain though more stocks fell.
newsitem.headline: Nasdaq shows moderate gain though more stocks fell.

text.p: Nasdaq shares showed an overall gain in a mixed session on Tuesday, but their advance paled in comparison to the 2.6 percent surge in the Dow industrials.
The Nasdaq composite index added 8.79 points, or 0.73 percent, to close unofficially at 1212.74. But declining issues beat advancers 2298 to 1938 on total volume of 626 million shares.

Nasdaq stocks largely missed out on Tuesday's buying spree among the Dow industrials. Market analysts said investors have shifted toward large-capitalization stocks with stable earnings, turning away from smaller, less predictable issues.
Nasdaq issues that showed gains Tuesday included technology leaders Microsoft Corp, Intel Corp and Dell Computer Corp.
"The big names, the semiconductors had a good day. But the Internet stocks were soft," said Brett Discher, vice president of equity trading at Dain Bosworth.
Big decliners included Eagle USA Airfreight Inc, which lost 8-5/8 to 21-7/8 after its second-quarter results failed to meet Wall Street expectations.
